question: Who among the following personalities is an exponent of the Manipuri dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajkumar Singhajit Singh**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajkumar Singhajit Singh**, is a main type, choreographer and a master of Indian traditional dance type of Manipuri, including the Pung cholom and Raslila.
 
• He was granted with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Grant in **1984.**
 
• The Padma Shri in **1986** for his commitment to the Manipuri dance.
 
• Rajkumar Singhajit Singh was brought into the world in a group of artists and performers in Manipur.
